title: Prospective, non-interventional study to evaluate the effectiveness and safety of Depigoid® products in patients suffering from allergic rhinitis/ rhinoconjunctivitis due to clinically relevant sensitization to storage mites, and to assess the clinical relevance of sensitization to storage mites.
summary:
This study aims to collect data from real-world medical practices on patients with allergies to storage mites. The aim is to determine how effective and safe treatment with specific allergy therapy products is for these patients during the first year. The study will last a total of 2 years, but each patient will only be monitored for around 13–14 months, depending on their treatment plan.

At least 75 adult and adolescent patients (aged 12 and over) are expected to take part, with at least 60 completing the study in full. To take part, patients must have a moderate to severe allergy to certain storage mites. Patients with controlled asthma may also participate.

Participants will be selected from the patient lists of the participating centres.

interventions.name: The total duration of observation of the individual patient is approximately 13 to 14 months, the total study duration is planned for 2 years. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
At the discretion of the study physician and based on the SmPC (May 2026, for Depigoid® rare allergens: tree, grass, herb pollen; mites)  for the Depigoid® product(s) used, participation in the study may be offered to male and female patients who 
o	are ≥12 years, 
o	have decided independently, together with their attending physician - according to routine clinical practice - and prior to their written consent for a study participation, to receive AIT with Depigoid® S-mite(s), as adequate treatment for their mite allergy/ies, 
o	have signed and dated written consents for 
•	participation in the study
•	data processing incl. medical history
by i) a legally competent patient or 
ii) for adolescents: self-completed (signed and dated) and consents of both parents/legal guardian(s),
o	are able to understand and communicate with the physician.
Exclusion criteria:
o	Any contraindication for treatment according to the SmPC (May 2026, Depigoid® rare allergens: tree, grass, herb pollen; mites) for the used Depigoid® product(s).
o	Any contraindication for AIT according to routine clinical practice. 
o	Known clinically relevant sensitization to other perennial allergens than mites (animal dander or molds).
